newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-O'NEAL, MOURNING AMONG RESERVES NAMED TO ALL-STAR GAME.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-O'NEAL, MOURNING AMONG RESERVES NAMED TO ALL-STAR GAME.

text.p: Centre Shaquille O'Neal and guard Eddie Jones of the Los Angeles Lakers and centre Alonzo Mourning and guard Tim Hardaway of the Miami Heat headed the list of reserves named Tuesday for next month's NBA All-Star Game.
The game will be played at Gund Arena in Cleveland on February 9.

Also named to the Western Conference team as reserves were guard Latrell Sprewell of the Golden State Warriors, guard Clyde Drexler of the Houston Rockets, forward Tom Gugliotta of the Minnesota Timberwolves, guard Mitch Richmond of the Sacramento Kings and forward Karl Malone of the Utah Jazz.

Named as Eastern reserves were forward Christian Laettner and centre Dikembe Mutombo of the Atlanta Hawks, guard Glen Rice of the Charlotte Hornets, forward Vin Baker of the Milwaukee Bucks and point guard Terrell Brandon of the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Reserves are selected by the NBA coaches, while the starters are voted in by the fans.

The starters at forward for the West are Charles Barkley of the Rockets and Shawn Kemp of the Seattle SuperSonics. The guards are Seattle's Gary Payton and Utah's John Stockton, with Houston's Hakeem Olajuwon at centre.

Eastern starters are forwards Scottie Pippen of the Chicago Bulls and Grant Hill of the Detroit Pistons, centre Patrick Ewing of the New York Knicks and guards Michael Jordan of the Bulls and Penny Hardaway of the Orlando Magic.
